data.content_ref: inline:The protocol authorizes reclamation via a BFT absence certificate, but the consensus participants have no causal mechanism to observe the crashed process’s local workspace. If evidence was completed locally yet the process crashed before publishing its hash to the ledger, the supermajority will truthfully certify that the ledger contains no such hash, allowing reclamation that silently displaces the sole copy of completed evidence remaining in the workspace.
